visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a close-up of an orange and blue rugged smartwatch resting on a clean white surface inside a brightly lit environment. (2) A young woman with long brown hair, wearing a white hoodie, appears behind a transparent glass shelf, looking surprised as she picks up the watch. (3) The scene shifts to an outdoor setting where the woman, now wearing a tan vest over her hoodie, holds the watch close to the camera, showcasing its digital face with various data widgets. (4) In a studio setting with a green background, the host stands behind three black product boxes, gesturing toward them as she introduces the new Garmin Instinct 3 series. (5) A series of rapid cuts follows, showing close-up shots of three different watch models: a neon yellow version, a seafoam green version, and the original orange/blue version, each in its respective box. (6) Detailed shots of the watch faces highlight specific technical features, including a 'Solar' indicator and various health data graphs, with bright daylight reflecting off the screens. (7) The host demonstrates the watch's integrated LED flashlight feature, cycling through a bright white beam and a red light in a dimly lit setting. (8) Transitioning back to the outdoors, the woman is seen walking in a park and performing stretching exercises while wearing the seafoam green watch, demonstrating its lifestyle and fitness application. (9) A close-up shows the watch being tapped against a green contactless payment terminal, with an orange band visible as the transaction is processed. (10) The video concludes with the host back in the studio, enthusiastically pointing towards the camera with the watches displayed in the foreground.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a high-arousal female greeting in Traditional Chinese, characterized by a bright spectral profile and enthusiastic rising intonation. An upbeat electronic pop track with a prominent 4/4 drum beat and synth stabs establishes a fast-paced energy. (2) A sharp 'whoosh' transition SFX triggers a shift to a male narrator with a professional, rhythmic delivery. The male voice exhibits high articulation clarity while describing technical watch specifications. The BGM maintains its steady tempo, and subtle 'pop' sound effects accentuate on-screen text appearances. (3) The female host returns briefly with a surprised vocal tone, her voice ducking slightly under a series of digital UI sound effects that mimic smartwatch notifications and screen taps. The environmental floor remains silent, indicating a high-quality studio mix. (4) As the scene transitions to the outdoors, a very faint ambient nature floor is audible, but the voice-over remains studio-clean. A distinct high-frequency mechanical 'beep' is heard when the host simulates a payment transaction. (5) The final phase features a return to the female host's voice, reaching a peak in vocal arousal as she delivers a CTA. The music swells in volume before a clean fade-out, ending on a bright, percussive electronic note.
